anomalies.observed: On sheet 1, 'Water Height Sensor', PR1 (LiDAR) is drawn without a DNP/no-connect marker and its pins are wired through header H1 (PB_1.25mm) to global labels I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL, with +5V and GND on the header. The TF-Luna module is therefore connected to the main non-isolated I2C bus in this build.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the LiDAR is documentation only in r2: 'per the netlist — its pins are "free" and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net', and 'PR1 with on_board: no ... all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free'. The intended design leaves PR1 unwired.

evidence.quote: A Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR module (PR1) is present in the r2 schematic/BOM ... but — per the netlist — its pins are "free" and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net. (§1 TL;DR)
the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design. (§4.3)
Sheet 1, block 'Water Height Sensor': PR1 LiDAR symbol connected via H1 PB_1.25mm to labels I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL, with +5V and GND on the same header; no DNP/no-connect marks on PR1.

anomalies.impact: The LiDAR is now an active device on the main I2C bus, loading the bus and drawing 5 V, contrary to the intended 'schematic documentation only' state; since the firmware contains no TF-Luna/uart block, this adds an unmanaged bus device and changes the water-level sensing path relative to the intended design.

parsed.summary: Most of the board matches the specification (power train, ADM3260 pH/EC isolation, three TMC2209 drivers, pump/valve drivers, float switches, DNP'd optional sensors), but the drawing deviates in one respect: PR1 (TF-Luna LiDAR), which the spec says is excluded and unwired, is shown connected to the main I2C_SDA/I2C_SCL bus through header H1.
